value.rationale: Fixed individual-gradient budget is a natural optimization invariant. The exact statewise oracle benchmark resolves whether information from the first noisy minibatch should be acted on before spending remaining samples; the strictly positive Jensen dividend is quantified by a sharp two-block high-signal universal limit. Uniqueness of the optimal split and the monotone dimension penalty distinguish this from a generic minibatch rate estimate or an arbitrary parameter slice. It is explicitly an ideal oracle benchmark, not a practical timing claim.
